title: AstralAzeta's Leather Tools
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/76a70a037b5a4c448bc8a21fa9f70b6c081eb27c.png) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Discord-Button-64.png)](https://discord.gg/hFS6faY9tW) [![Alt Text](https://tr7zw.github.io/uikit/social_buttons_icon/Modrinth-Button-64.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/astralazetas-leather-tools)
This mod adds leather tools. They are useless, because you need leather to craft them and they do almost no damage.
